mapper.select: SELECT user_id, email, phone, user_name, email_encrypted, email_hmac, phone_encrypted, phone_hmac, user_name_encrypted FROM `user` WHERE user_id > #{afterId} ORDER BY user_id LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT family_id, family_name, birth_date, family_name_encrypted, birth_date_encrypted FROM family WHERE family_id > #{afterId} ORDER BY family_id LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.update: UPDATE `user` SET email_encrypted = #{emailEncrypted}, email_hmac = #{emailHmac}, phone_encrypted = #{phoneEncrypted}, phone_hmac = #{phoneHmac}, user_name_encrypted = #{userNameEncrypted} WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND email_encrypted IS NULL AND email_hmac IS NULL AND phone_encrypted IS NULL AND phone_hmac IS NULL AND user_name_encrypted IS NULL
